summary: San Bernardino NF lookout built 1926, destroyed in the September 2024 Line Fire; reports say only the steel framework remains.

facts.design: likely a Region 5 4AR cabin on a 20-foot open steel tower (1926); cab replaced with a Region 5 BC-301 in 1954
facts.status_note: destroyed in the September 2024 Line Fire; Hundred Peaks reports only the steel framework remains; NHLR says rebuilding discussions are underway

staffing.status: volunteer-staffed in fire season until 2024; destroyed since

access.note: no lookout cab to enter; the summit is reached by Keller Peak Road, where a gate can add several miles when closed

visit.trail_note: drive-up on Keller Peak Road per Hundred Peaks; the lookout itself was destroyed in 2024

destroyed in the September 2024 Line Fire; only the steel framework reported left

corrections.why: The lookout was destroyed in the September 2024 Line Fire. NHLR lists it as removed in 2024, and Hundred Peaks reports only the steel framework remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites Register says the cab was replaced with a Region 5 BC-301 in 1954. A June 16, 1954 newspaper item quoted on californialookouts.weebly.com says the whole tower was torn down and a new one was being set up. The story reports both without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Destruction in the September 2024 Line Fire is stated by NHLR and Hundred Peaks, but I could not open the Mountain News article (HTTP 429 on every attempt), so the fire's exact date and the 'steel framework only' detail rest on Hundred Peaks alone. Rebuilding status is unverified, and the register's statement carries no date. The 1954 tower-versus-cab question is unresolved. The brief's 'standing' status was corrected. Access was set to restricted because nothing remains to enter; the brief had 'unknown'. Staffing as_of is the 2024 destruction year. The californialookouts page is a compilation of newspaper clippings with its own dating; the story's 1929 and 1954 dates are the report dates July 18, 1929 and June 16, 1954. Fact-check 2026-10-08: 'San Bernardino Mountains' was replaced by the register's San Bernardino National Forest, and 'no tower left to climb' by 'no cab to visit', because the sources say the lookout was destroyed but do not say the steel framework is unclimbable.
